name: WENO5-JS flux form with a deliberate typo: 1/3 instead of 1/4 in beta_1
source: weno5-js-fd.json with one coefficient changed, to show what a transcription error does

claims.why: eps fixed: omega_k - d_k = O(beta/eps) = O(dx^2) whatever the beta coefficients, so the typo is invisible asymptotically
leading betas f'^2 dx^2 (1, 4/3, 1): the limit weights are not d_k, so the dx^3 candidate errors do not cancel
at f'(x_i) = 0 the 1/4 terms are O(dx^6) against (13/12) f''^2 dx^4, so the typo enters the weights at O(dx^2) only
convex weights: each reconstruction is O(dx^3), the difference O(dx^2)
at the i-1/2 stencil f' = -f'' dx, so the first-difference terms are (f'' dx^2)^2, as large as the 13/12 terms; with the typo the leading betas differ and the limit weights are not d_k there
